battle.name: 第五次中東戰爭
battle.theater: 黎巴嫩南部與貝卡谷地
battle.brief: 1982年6月6日，以色列以「和平為加利利」為名越過利塔尼河，大軍同時攻入黎巴嫩，戰線北推至貝卡谷地與大馬士革城下，並於6月9日摧毀敘利亞在谷地的導彈防線。卡面1840年法國雷管步槍代表線列步兵的最後一代火器：射程延長、隊形散開，而本役的分散與機動作戰，正是這條技術路線的終點。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 第五次中東戰爭（1982年黎巴嫩戰爭）在以色列與駐黎巴嫩的巴勒斯坦解放組織及其盟友之間展開，敘利亞與黎巴嫩政府軍亦直接參與。開戰前以色列國防軍在黎南部已設立「安全區」，由南方司令部統一指揮；總參謀長拉斐爾·艾坦中將主持作戰方案，南方司令部司令阿維多爾·本-加利少將在前線指揮，第162師由阿夫拉罕·塔米爾少將、第200師由阿米·阿雅隆少將、第252師與裝甲師分別擔任主攻與擴張任務，並有工程兵、航空兵與海軍特遣支隊協同。巴勒斯坦解放組織方面由亞西爾·阿拉法特在貝魯特統率最高決策，旗下法塔赫、伊斯蘭聖戰組織等武裝分駐貝魯特、提里特、西頓與南部各口岸，另有薩阿德·哈達德率領的「自由黎巴嫩軍」配合以軍作戰。黎巴嫩軍由總統埃利亞斯·薩基斯與武裝部隊總司令約瑟夫·薩阿德主持，第八步兵師在戰事初期倒戈，其餘各師則在倒戈與抵抗之間分裂。敘利亞以總統哈菲茲·阿薩德與參謀長穆斯塔法·塔拉斯調兵，第3步兵師、第10空降師與第3裝甲師自貝卡谷地南緣進入黎境，在黎巴嫩境內與以色列形成正面對抗。
countriesEn: The Fifth Middle East War, the Lebanon War of 1982, was fought between Israel on one side and the Palestine Liberation Organization and its allies deployed in Lebanon on the other, with Syria and the Lebanese government army taking a direct part. Before the fighting began the Israel Defense Forces already held a security zone in southern Lebanon under a single command. Chief of Staff Maj Gen Rafael Eitan presided over the operational plan, Southern Command under Maj Gen Avigdor Ben-Gal ran the front, and the 162nd Division under Maj Gen Avraham Tamir, the 200th Division under Maj Gen Ami Ayalon, the 252nd Division and the Armoured Division carried the main attack and the follow-up, with engineers, air units and a naval task group in support. On the PLO side Yasser Arafat took the highest decisions from Beirut; Fatah and the Islamic Jihad Organisation among others were spread over Beirut, Tyre, Sidon and the southern approaches, while the Free Lebanon Army led by Saad Haddad operated alongside the Israeli forces. The Lebanese armed forces were nominally under President Elias Sarkis and the commander-in-chief Joseph Saadeh, but the 8th Infantry Division went over to the other side in the opening days while the remaining formations split between defection and resistance. Syria committed forces under President Hafez al-Assad and Chief of Staff Mustafa Tlass: the 3rd Infantry Division, the 10th Airborne Division and the 3rd Armoured Division came in from the southern edge of the Bekaa Valley to confront Israel head on inside Lebanon.
people: 關鍵人物集中在三方的最高統帥與前線指揮官。以色列總理梅納赫姆·貝京任內堅持對巴勒斯坦解放組織採取「北方方案」，國防部長阿里埃爾·沙龍力主向北推進至戈蘭方向，總參謀長拉斐爾·艾坦中將擬定並執行作戰方案，南方司令部司令本-加利少將在戰役首日指揮利塔尼河的突破。裝甲師在貝卡谷地的推進、第162師沿海岸線的競進，以及傘兵突降貝魯特西區的戰術，都由前線指揮官逐級落實。巴勒斯坦解放組織方面，阿拉法特主持最高指揮部，哈利勒·瓦齊爾（阿布·賈希德）主管軍事物資與訓練，薩利赫·哈利勒統率在黎境內的作戰部隊；貝魯特西區的抵抗最終在拉希德·卡拉基與艾哈邁德·賈里迪指揮下瓦解，兩人於8月陣亡。敘利亞方面，除總統阿薩德與參謀長塔拉斯外，貝卡戰區由敘軍中部地區司令部統一協調，第3步兵師師長沙菲克·法耶德在6月9日的空戰中陣亡。技術層面上，以色列工程兵在利塔尼河「針尖」渡河點架設浮橋，以及電子戰與地空協同的運用，是本役最具決定性的技術動作。
peopleEn: The decisive figures were the supreme commanders and the front-line commanders of the three sides. In Israel Prime Minister Menachem Begin insisted on the northern option against the Palestine Liberation Organization, Defence Minister Ariel Sharon pressed for the drive north towards the Golan, Chief of Staff Maj Gen Rafael Eitan drew up and executed the operational plan, and Southern Command under Maj Gen Ben-Gal directed the crossing of the Litani on the first day. The armoured drive through the Bekaa, the race along the coast by the 162nd Division and the airborne landings in West Beirut were carried out step by step by the front-line commanders. On the PLO side Arafat headed the high command, Khalil al-Wazir (Abu Jihad) ran military supply and training, and Saleh Khalileh commanded the armed formations inside Lebanon; the resistance in West Beirut finally collapsed under Rashid Karaki and Ahmed Jelladi, both of whom were killed in August. On the Syrian side, besides President Assad and Chief of Staff Tlass, the Bekaa direction was run by the Syrian central-region command, and the commander of the 3rd Infantry Division, Shafiq Fayadh, was killed in the air battle of 9 June. At the technical level the most decisive acts of the campaign were the bridging of the Litani at the Pinpoint crossing by the Israeli engineers and the combination of electronic warfare with air-ground cooperation.
kits: 卡面那支1840年法國雷管步槍屬於線列步兵的最後一代火器：底火取代火燧後，槍管可以承受更強的裝藥，射程從百餘米延伸到三四百米，密集的線列隊形因此解體，步兵改以散兵與射擊精度取勝。1982年的黎巴嫩戰場上，這條技術路線早已走到盡頭：以色列步兵的標準步槍是5.56公厘的「加利爾」與「烏齊」衝鋒槍，預備役與民兵仍用二十世紀前半的栓動步槍；營級火力換成「梅卡瓦」主戰坦克、M-60「百夫長」、M-113裝甲車與英國「中坦克」改裝型，砲兵是105與155公厘自行榴彈炮，並首次實戰使用美製M-270多管火箭炮。敘利亞方面以T-72與T-62中型坦克、BMP-2裝步車、ZSU-23-4自走高炮組成快速機動打擊群，火箭炮同樣是M-270；空軍有MiG-21、MiG-23戰鬥機與Su-22攻擊機。巴勒斯坦解放組織與黎巴嫩軍的裝備仍以技術車、反戰車火箭筒與輕機槍為主，只有零星坦克。海空方面，以色列有「薩阿」級導彈艇、首批「刀鋒」級無人艇（以「加布里爾」飛彈攻擊敘軍雷達）與「幼獅」戰鬥機，敘利亞有「卡辛」級驅逐艦；6月6日以軍飛彈艇擊沉「卡辛」號與兩艘導彈艇，以軍驅逐艦「埃拉特」號則被改裝成發射平台的IL-76加油機以「魚叉」反艦飛彈擊中，47名官兵殉難；此處的「埃拉特」號與1973年陣亡的同名牌艦並非同船，而是以軍沿用的第二艘同名驅逐艦。
kitsEn: The 1840 French percussion rifle on the card belongs to the last generation of line infantry arms: once the priming system replaced the matchlock the barrel could take stronger charges, effective range grew from little more than a hundred metres to three or four hundred, and the dense line formations broke up as infantry came to rely on dispersion and on accuracy of fire. On the Lebanese battlefield of 1982 that technical line had run to its end. The standard rifle of the Israeli infantryman was the 5.56mm Galil and the Uzi submachine gun, while reserves and the militia still carried bolt-action rifles of the first half of the twentieth century. At battalion level the firepower had become the Merkava main battle tank, the M-60 Patton, the M-113 armoured car and converted Centurions; the artillery was 105mm and 155mm self-propelled howitzers, and the American M-270 multiple rocket launcher was used in combat for the first time. The Syrians formed fast manoeuvre groups around T-72 and T-62 medium tanks, BMP-2 infantry fighting vehicles and ZSU-23-4 anti-aircraft guns, with the same M-270 rocket launcher; their air force fielded MiG-21 and MiG-23 fighters and Su-22 strike aircraft. The equipment of the PLO and the Lebanese army remained technicals, anti-tank rocket launchers and light machine guns, with only a handful of tanks. At sea Israel had Sa'ar class missile boats and the first batch of Dvora-class unmanned surface vessels, which fired Gabriel missiles at Syrian radar stations, together with the Kfir fighter, while Syria had Kashin-class destroyers. On 6 June Israeli missile boats sank the Kashin and two missile boats, and the Israeli destroyer Eilat was hit by a Harpoon fired from an IL-76 tanker converted into a launcher, 47 of her crew being killed; this Eilat was not the ship of the same name lost in 1973, but the second vessel of that name kept by the Israeli navy.
tactics: 6月6日凌晨，以色列以三個方向同時發動攻擊：西線沿海岸線北上，目標是提里特與西頓；中線在利塔尼河「針尖」渡河點由工程兵架設浮橋，把戰車縱隊一批一批送過河；東線由裝甲師切入貝卡谷地，企圖切斷大馬士革與戈蘭之間的公路並阻止敘軍增援。第一日越境者約六萬人、坦克逾八百輛，另有海軍突擊隊與傘兵在提里特以北的海岸登陸，建立灘頭後由三艘登陸艇持續輸送人員與裝甲，登陸前飛彈艇與飛機在登陸區以外實施干擾性轟炸。火力準備以空軍為主，攻擊機群低空進入谷地，在不到兩小時內摧毀敘軍地空導彈陣地的大部分發射車，使地面部隊得以在雷達盲區內推進；飛彈艇在十天戰鬥中共射擊76公厘砲彈3,500發。6月9日，以軍在谷地上空發動「蟋蟀行動十九號」，宣稱擊落敘機29架並摧毀17個導彈連，其後逐批消耗對方戰機取得制空權；地面同時沿艾因傑爾與馬勒容一線向大馬士革方向推進，逼近而未進入該市，6月12日在貝魯特南郊卡弗爾西勒與敘軍及解放組織的聯合部隊接觸。解放組織在貝魯特西區組成縱深據點，以反戰車火箭筒與地雷遲滯以軍，7月至8月以軍以逐點攻擊加上空襲的辦法壓縮其陣地，最終迫使對方簽署撤離協議。整體而言，本役是機械化縱隊在掩護火力與制空權配合下的高速推進，與十九世紀步兵依托線列與齊射的樣式已無相似之處。
tacticsEn: Israel opened the attack in the small hours of 6 June on three axes: in the west a drive north along the coast towards Tyre and Sidon; in the centre the engineers bridged the Litani at the Pinpoint crossing, feeding the armoured columns across in successive batches; and in the east the Armoured Division cut into the Bekaa Valley in an attempt to sever the road between Damascus and the Golan and to stop Syrian reinforcement. About 60,000 men and more than 800 tanks crossed the border on the first day, while naval commandos and paratroopers landed on the coast north of Tyre, established a beachhead and then received men and armour continuously from three landing craft, the bombardment by missile boats and aircraft falling on an area away from the landing zone. The preparation was carried mainly by the air force, whose strike groups went in low over the valley and destroyed most of the launchers of the Syrian surface-to-air missile positions in under two hours, leaving the ground troops free to advance inside a radar shadow; the missile boats fired 3,500 rounds of 76mm gun over the ten days of fighting. On 9 June the Israeli Air Force launched Operation Mole Cricket 19 over the valley, claiming 29 Syrian aircraft shot down and 17 missile batteries destroyed, and thereafter wore down the opposing fighters in successive batches until it had control of the air; on the ground the push continued along the Ain Jir and Marjayoun axis towards Damascus, coming close without entering the city, and on 12 June it met a joint Syrian and PLO force at Kafr Sill on the southern outskirts of Beirut. The PLO built deep positions in West Beirut, delaying the Israeli advance with anti-tank rocket launchers and mines, and between July and August the Israeli attack worked through those positions one by one under heavy air strike until the PLO was driven to sign an evacuation agreement. In overall terms the campaign was a high-speed advance by mechanised columns under covering fire and air superiority, and it bears little resemblance to the nineteenth-century infantry standing in line and firing in volleys.
data: 時間：1982年6月6日開火，6月12日以軍推進到貝魯特南郊卡弗爾西勒一線，以敘停火並延伸至解放組織，圍困西貝魯特持續到8月，解放組織武裝人員於8月底至9月分批撤離黎巴嫩，戰爭以撤軍行動延續到1985年6月5日以軍主力撤出為止。兵力：開戰首日在三個方向越境者約六萬人、坦克逾八百輛；以軍在黎巴嫩全期兵力約七萬八千人、坦克一千二百四十輛、裝甲車一千五百輛，分五個師與兩個加強旅級單位部署；解放組織在黎境武裝分布於十一個營區，砲兵由1981年7月的80門增至1982年6月的250門；敘利亞先投入第3步兵師，6月9日再投入第10空降師與第3裝甲師。損失：以色列公布1982至1985年陣亡654人、受傷3,887人，損失飛機1架、直升機2架；解放組織陣亡1,000至2,400人、被俘約6,000人；敘利亞陣亡1,200人、被俘296人，損失坦克300至350輛、裝甲車150輛、砲約100門、飛機82至86架、直升機12架、地空導彈連29個；各方公布合計陣亡約19,085人、受傷約30,000人。空戰：6月9日的「蟋蟀行動十九號」中以軍宣稱擊落敘機29架，同時摧毀敘軍17個導彈連。本役亦集中創下多項首次：M-270多管火箭炮首次實戰、「加利爾」步槍首次大規模配發、「梅卡瓦」坦克首次投入戰鬥（對手正是敘軍T-72）、BMP-2首次上戰場，AH-1S「眼鏡蛇」武裝直升機更早在4月已投入貝卡的地面攻擊。
dataEn: Duration: fire opened on 6 June 1982; on 12 June the Israeli advance reached Kafr Sill on the southern outskirts of Beirut, where the Israeli-Syrian cease-fire was extended to the PLO; the siege of West Beirut ran on until August, the PLO fighters withdrawing from Lebanon in stages during August and September, and the war continued through the withdrawal operations until most Israeli forces had left on 5 June 1985. Manpower: about 60,000 men and more than 800 tanks crossed the border on the first day in three directions; the Israeli force in Lebanon over the whole campaign numbered about 78,000 men with 1,240 tanks and 1,500 armoured personnel carriers, deployed in five divisions and two reinforced brigade-size units; the PLO had eleven battalion areas in Lebanon and its artillery grew from 80 guns in July 1981 to 250 in June 1982; Syria committed the 3rd Infantry Division first, then the 10th Airborne Division and the 3rd Armoured Division on 9 June. Losses: Israel published 654 dead and 3,887 wounded for 1982 to 1985, losing one aircraft and two helicopters; the PLO lost 1,000 to 2,400 killed with about 6,000 captured; Syria lost 1,200 killed and 296 captured, together with 300 to 350 tanks, 150 armoured personnel carriers, about 100 artillery pieces, 82 to 86 aircraft, 12 helicopters and 29 surface-to-air missile batteries; the published totals run to about 19,085 killed and 30,000 wounded. Air: in Operation Mole Cricket 19 on 9 June Israel claimed 29 Syrian aircraft shot down and 17 missile batteries destroyed. The campaign also gathered several firsts into one: the first combat use of the M-270 multiple rocket launcher, the first large-scale issue of the Galil rifle, the Merkava tank's first appearance in combat against the Syrian T-72, the BMP-2's battlefield debut, and the AH-1S Cobra, which had already gone into action on the ground in the Bekaa back in April.
cause: 衝突的根源是巴勒斯坦解放組織自1970年黑九月之後把黎巴嫩當作對以色列作戰的基地，而以色列堅持解除其武裝並將其驅逐。1978年的「利塔尼行動」與1981年的再度入侵已把以軍的邊界推到利塔尼河一線，1982年4月28日以軍突襲貝魯特的解放組織總部，擊斃多名指揮官並摧毀其辦公與指揮設施，解放組織隨即以北境為目標發動砲擊，以軍還擊之後雙方再度走向全面對抗。同一時期以軍內部長期存在兩種方案：只控制到利塔尼河為止的「北方方案」，與以北軍為跳板直取大馬士革與戈蘭的深入方案；貝京與沙龍支持後者，而黎巴嫩的分裂與脆弱更令以方相信，一旦戰端打開，解放組織的火箭砲與外來武器將難以阻擋。敘利亞自1981年起以「阿拉伯威懾部隊」的名義向黎境派駐部隊，並把地空導彈部署進貝卡谷地，一旦以色列推進到河谷，敘軍在黎的導彈網與其在戈蘭的前沿即將被一併切斷。黎巴嫩政府先前簽署的1982年4月17日臨時協議未能落實，1975年以黎協議的執行落差，令貝魯特成為三方軍力重疊而指揮真空的地帶。
causeEn: The root of the conflict lay in the PLO's use of Lebanon, after Black September in 1970, as its base for operations against Israel, while Israel insisted on disarming it and driving it out. Operation Litani of 1978 and a further invasion in 1981 had already pushed the Israeli line up to the Litani, and on 28 April 1982 the Israeli air force raided the PLO headquarters in Beirut, killing several commanders and wrecking the offices and command installations there; the PLO answered by shelling the northern towns, and after the Israeli return fire the two sides slid once again towards general war. At the same time the Israeli command had long debated two plans: the northern option, which would stop at the Litani, and the deeper plan to use the Lebanese army as a springboard for Damascus and the Golan. Begin and Sharon supported the latter, and the division and weakness of Lebanon convinced them that once the shooting started, PLO rocket fire and foreign weapons would be very hard to hold back. Since 1981 Syria had been sending troops into Lebanon under the banner of the Arab Deterrent Force and had deployed air defence missiles into the Bekaa; once Israel pushed into the valley, both the Syrian missile net in Lebanon and the Syrian forward position in the Golan would be cut in one stroke. The interim agreement of 17 April 1982 signed with Beirut had not been implemented, and the gap between the 1975 Israel-Lebanon agreement and its actual execution left the capital in a state of overlapping forces and empty command.
impact: 本役重塑了黎巴嫩與中東的軍力對比，也改變了以色列的戰略慣例。貝卡谷地防空戰顯示，由蘇聯供應的防空系統在缺少電子戰支援時可以被打成癱瘓，僅靠飛彈發射車與陣地掩體不足以抵禦低空高速打擊，這一教訓後來被美國與歐洲在海灣戰爭中重新演繹，也促使各國加建反輻射飛彈與專用電子戰吊艙。以軍的戰術則從邊境清剿轉向縱深機動作戰與快速反應部隊的建設，裝甲師、空降旅與預備役的編組在此役後大幅擴充，以色列在黎巴嫩南部留下的「安全區」更把一場戰爭變成長期的邊境現實。政治上，巴勒斯坦解放組織失去在黎巴嫩的基地而把總部遷往突尼斯，其武裝化程度與軍事聲望反而在隨後的黎巴嫩內戰中達到頂點；黎巴嫩軍隊的分裂則為內戰埋下伏筆。外交上，美國以助理國務卿菲利普·哈比為特使促成8月18日協議與9月美軍海軍陸戰隊進駐，聯合國部隊在黎境的存在被削弱，1983年以黎條約最終未獲黎巴嫩政府批准。
impactEn: This war rewrote the balance of military power in Lebanon and the Middle East and changed the habits of Israeli strategy. The battle for the Bekaa showed that a Soviet-supplied air defence system, unsupported by electronic warfare, could be paralysed, and that launchers and revetted positions alone could not survive low-level high-speed attack; the lesson was played out again by the United States and by Europe in the Gulf War, and it pushed every air force towards dedicated anti-radiation missiles and electronic warfare pods. The Israeli doctrine moved from border sweeps to deep manoeuvre and to the building of fast reaction forces, and the armoured divisions, airborne brigades and reserve system were all expanded after the campaign, while the security zone left in southern Lebanon turned a war into a permanent border reality. Politically the PLO lost its base in Lebanon and moved its headquarters to Tunis, and its armed strength and military prestige reached their peak in the Lebanese civil war that followed; the splitting of the Lebanese army was a prelude to that civil war. Diplomatically, Assistant Secretary of State Philip Habib negotiated the agreement of 18 August and the entry of the American Marine expeditionary unit in September, the presence of the United Nations force in Lebanon was weakened, and the Israel-Lebanon treaty of 1983 was never approved by the Lebanese government.

resultEn: By 12 June Israel held every key point in southern Lebanon north of the Litani and had occupied West Beirut and the Bekaa Valley up to the gates of Damascus; the commander of the Syrian 3rd Infantry Division had been killed, almost every missile launcher in the valley destroyed, Syria's position in southern Lebanon wiped out, and the PLO compressed into the deep positions of West Beirut. From July to August the siege was fought by reducing position after position under heavy air strike, and in August the Israeli forces broke into the last PLO positions; between the end of August and September more than 14,000 PLO fighters left Lebanon in stages for Tunisia and elsewhere, while several thousand more armed Lebanese departed under Israeli supervision; the Israeli-Syrian cease-fire had been reached on 12 June, and the main Syrian forces withdrew from Lebanon in September. Israel neither advanced on Damascus nor overturned the pro-Israeli government in Beirut; it chose instead to keep the security zone in the south and maintain the blockade of the PLO, and the theatre became permanently militarised, so that only in June 1985 did the Israeli forces begin to withdraw in stages. The cost was just as clear: the military and political order of the Lebanese state disintegrated further, the war bought no effective Israel-Lebanon peace treaty at all, and the treaty signed in May 1983 lapsed into nothing because the Lebanese parliament opposed it and civil war broke out.
